annotations.title: Batch Get HK Company Statutory Profiles

description: Batch query holographic statutory profiles of 1 to 10 Hong Kong companies simultaneously. Works WITHOUT an API key (3 free companies/day per IP; 20 free companies/day with a free API key from https://www.86hc.com/user). Returns Chinese/English legal names, 7-digit CR No., 8-digit Business Registration Number (BRN) & exemption status, live/dissolved status, incorporation date, annual return date (MM-DD), entity type, governing law (Cap. 622), registered office address, historical former names, and verified ICRIS statutory filings summary with authentic barcodes.

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

companies.description: Array of 1 to 10 company identifiers (7-digit CR number, 8-digit BRN, or exact Chinese/English company name).

identifiers.description: Alias for companies: array of 1 to 10 company identifiers (CR number, 8-digit BRN, or company name).

name: batch_get_company_details
